# Brainstorm stops before checklist step 4 in all three runs

In each run, step 2 (Set up the worktree) stops before any worktree is created. So there is no first step-4 message and no approaches message. `reference/legs.md` says to validate every selected declaration before creating any tree. A selected path that is missing, is not a git repository, or equals home "stops naming the line."

The ask explicitly selects `repo-b`, so its `## shape-ticket` `- sibling: ../repo-b` declaration is validated. That path is resolved against the home primary `/work/repo-a` and canonicalized before the home comparison. The unselected `../repo-c` is never resolved or validated, because legs.md says to never resolve or validate unselected sibling paths. Its missing path therefore does not affect any run.

No trees were created in any run, so no `Preserved created legs:` list applies.

---

### Run A: `../repo-b` does not exist

> Stopping before worktree setup. The selected sibling declaration `- sibling: ../repo-b` (home `/work/repo-a` overrides, `## shape-ticket`) resolves to `/work/repo-b`, which does not exist. No worktree was created for any member. Fix or remove that declaration, or create the `repo-b` checkout at that path, then restart the brainstorm.

### Run B: `../repo-b` is a symlink to `/work/repo-a`

> Stopping before worktree setup. The selected sibling declaration `- sibling: ../repo-b` (home `/work/repo-a` overrides, `## shape-ticket`) resolves to `/work/repo-b`, which canonicalizes to `/work/repo-a`. That is the home primary itself, so it cannot be a separate leg. No worktree was created for any member. Point the declaration at the real `repo-b` checkout, or drop `repo-b` from the ask to continue single-member, then restart the brainstorm.

### Run C: `../repo-b` exists but is not a git repository

> Stopping before worktree setup. The selected sibling declaration `- sibling: ../repo-b` (home `/work/repo-a` overrides, `## shape-ticket`) resolves to `/work/repo-b`, which exists but is not a git repository. No worktree was created for any member. Point the declaration at a git checkout of `repo-b`, or initialize or clone it there, then restart the brainstorm.
